x_note: MapOpt controller data: the Map assist table with lead and lag, designed by simultaneous optimisation of J = R*S (the MapPID method), a new controller separate from Map. Ts_ctrl [s]. The dry-road calibration points are read from data/map.json (data, not design). design: written by Controllers/MapOpt/script/select_mapopt.m: Kmax, Ts0, lead {z, p}, lag {z1, p1} [rad/s]. Absent: load_mapopt.m loads the Map design of map.json (the check of build_mapopt / test_mapopt).

design.rule: min J = R*S by simultaneous optimisation (surrogateopt x3 + patternsearch x3), the MapPID method; PM >= 30, GM >= 2, calib_margin
